items.title: odf-kit: HTML injection leading to XSS in odtToHtml() and odsToHtml() via unescaped style attribute values
items.summary: ### Summary ODF style attribute values are interpolated into `style="..."` attributes without HTML-escaping in **both** of odf-kit's to-HTML renderers (`odtToHtml` and `odsToHtml`). A double-quote character inside an attacker-controlled style value breaks out of the attribute, allowing arbitrary HTML/attribute injection — and therefore script execution (XSS) — from a crafted `.odt` or `.ods` file wherever the rendered output is inserted as HTML, which is the documented purpose of both functions.
